title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
rawExcerpt: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.
